hero.description1: NuMee helps you understand where you are, where you could be in the future, and will guide toward your ambitions.
hero.description2: Your AI-powered personal mentor (YPM) maps your skills against real job profile, finds the gaps, and builds a personalized roadmaps - so you can move forward with confidence.

empower.title: NuMee is here to empower every career journey with personalized roadmaps
empower.paragraph1: We believe every professional deserves a clear path from where they are to where they want to be. Our platform uses AI to map your skills, identify gaps, and create actionable steps.
empower.paragraph2: From assessments to mentorship and networking, NuMee supports you at every stage so you can move forward with confidence.

footer.tagline: AI-powered career guidance. Personalized roadmaps, skill assessments, and mentorship for every ambition.
